meta.title: Key stage 4 (GCSE) performance by local authority
meta.quality: Accredited official statistics (state-funded schools, by school location). The latest year is provisional (October release) and is revised in February.
meta.limitations: 2019/20 not published; 2020/21 teacher-assessed grades and 2021/22 transitional grading are not comparable with 2022/23 onwards (2020/21 rows carry a note). EBacc entry is taken from data set version 1.0.1 because the EBacc measure was removed from the 2025/26 release. Progress 8 is not available for 2024/25-2025/26 (no KS2 baseline) so is omitted. Disadvantaged gap here is the simple difference in average A8 between not-disadvantaged and disadvantaged pupils, not DfE's national gap index. Bedfordshire figures recomputed from summed numerators/denominators. LA = school location, state-funded only (independent schools excluded).

indicators.label: Average Attainment 8 score
indicators.description: Mean Attainment 8 score per pupil at the end of KS4, state-funded schools.

indicators.label: % grade 5+ in English and maths
indicators.description: Percentage of pupils achieving grade 5 or above in both English and maths GCSEs (strong pass).

indicators.label: % grade 4+ in English and maths
indicators.description: Percentage achieving grade 4+ in English and maths (standard pass; below this, maths/English resits are compulsory post-16).

indicators.label: % entering the EBacc
indicators.description: Percentage of pupils entering all English Baccalaureate pillars (to 2024/25).

indicators.label: Pupils at the end of KS4
indicators.description: Number of pupils at the end of key stage 4 (state-funded) - annual flow into post-16 education and training.

indicators.label: Average A8 - disadvantaged pupils
indicators.description: Attainment 8 for pupils eligible for FSM in the last six years or looked after.

indicators.label: Average A8 - other pupils
indicators.description: Attainment 8 for pupils not known to be disadvantaged.

indicators.label: Disadvantage gap in Attainment 8 (points)
indicators.description: Average A8 of non-disadvantaged minus disadvantaged pupils.

indicators.label: % of KS4 cohort disadvantaged
indicators.description: Disadvantaged pupils as a share of the end-of-KS4 cohort.
